### Load Clinical Data

```{r}
clin_raw <- read.delim("brca_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018/data_clinical_patient.txt", sep = '\t',skip = 4)
rownames(clin_raw) <- clin_raw$PATIENT_ID
```

### Load and Process RNA data

```{r}
RNA_raw <- read.delim("brca_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018/data_mrna_seq_v2_rsem_zscores_ref_all_samples.txt",check.names = FALSE)
RNA_raw[is.na(RNA_raw)] <- 0
RNA_raw <- RNA_raw[RNA_raw$Hugo_Symbol!='',]
RNA_raw <- RNA_raw[!duplicated(RNA_raw$Hugo_Symbol),]
rownames(RNA_raw) <- RNA_raw$Hugo_Symbol
RNA <- as.data.frame(t(RNA_raw[-1:-2]))
```

## Basal Subtype Filtering

```{r}
# Aligning clinical data}
clin <- clin_raw[str_sub(row.names(RNA), end = -4),]

# Identifying Basal pats 
basal_ids <- rownames(clin)[clin$SUBTYPE == "BRCA_Basal"]

#Subset RNA and clinical to basal
basal_RNA <- RNA[rownames(RNA) %in%
                   paste0(basal_ids, "-01"), ]
basal_clin <- clin[clin$SUBTYPE == "BRCA_Basal", ]

#No. of basal pats
cat("No. of Basal Patients:", nrow(basal_clin), "\n")

RNA <- basal_RNA
clin <- basal_clin

```

## Load and Process CNA data

```{r}
CNA_raw <- read.delim("brca_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018/data_cna.txt",check.names = FALSE)

#cleaning
CNA_raw <- CNA_raw[CNA_raw$Hugo_Symbol!='',]
CNA_raw <- CNA_raw[!duplicated(CNA_raw$Hugo_Symbol),]
rownames(CNA_raw) <- CNA_raw$Hugo_Symbol

#transpose (r = pats, cols = genes)
CNA <- as.data.frame(t(CNA_raw[ , -1:-2]))

basal_CNA <- CNA[rownames(RNA), ]
basal_CNA[is.na(basal_CNA)] <- 0

cat("CNA matrix dimensions:", nrow(basal_CNA), "x", ncol(basal_CNA), "\n")
```

## Integrate RNA and CNA data

```{r}
#genes present in both datasets
common_genes <- intersect(colnames(RNA), colnames(basal_CNA))
cat("Common genes between RNA ad CNA:", length(common_genes), "\n")


common_RNA <- RNA[ , common_genes]
common_CNA <- basal_CNA[ , common_genes]

#identifying amplified genes per pat (CNA +2 = high)
amplification_freq <- colMeans(common_CNA == 2)

#identifying highly expressed genes (mean z-score > 1 for basal pats)
highly_exp <- colMeans(common_RNA) > 1

#genes both frequently amplified (>10% pats) and highly expressed 
integrated_genes <- names(amplification_freq)[amplification_freq > 0.10 & highly_exp]
cat("Genes that are amplified and highly expressed for Basal subtype:", 
    length(integrated_genes), "\n")
print(integrated_genes)

#visualisation
amplification_df <- data.frame(
  Gene = names(amplification_freq),
  Amp_Frequency = amplification_freq
) %>%
  filter(Gene %in% integrated_genes) %>%
  arrange(desc(Amp_Frequency))

ggplot(amplification_df, aes(x = reorder(Gene, Amp_Frequency), y = Amp_Frequency)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', fill = 'firebrick') +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = 'Genes that are Amplified and Highly Expressed in Basal',
       x = 'Gene', y = '% of patients with amplification')

```

## Create Survival Object

```{r}
# create a survival object consisting of times & censoring
surv_obj <- Surv(time = clin$OS_MONTHS, 
                 event = clin$OS_STATUS=="1:DECEASED")
```

## Overall SUrvival KM Curve

```{r}
#surv_obj 

fit <- survfit(surv_obj ~ 1, data = clin)
ggsurvplot(fit, data = clin, xlab = "Month", ylab = "Overall survival")
```

## Hazard Ratio KRAS and TP53

```{r}
# fit multivariate  COX proportional hazard model for some specific genes
fit.coxph <- coxph(surv_obj ~ KRAS + TP53, 
                   data = RNA)
ggforest(fit.coxph, data = RNA)
```

## Progeny pathway scoring

```{r}
zscores = as.matrix(t(RNA))
pathways <- progeny(zscores, scale=TRUE, organism="Human")  #, top = 100, perm = 1)
path_df <- as.data.frame(pathways)

# fit multivariate  COX proportional hazard model for some specific paythways
fit.coxph <- coxph(surv_obj ~ MAPK + `JAK-STAT`, data = path_df)
ggforest(fit.coxph, data = path_df)
```


### ilter zero survival times

```{r}
# now creating object without zero times

RNA_filt <- RNA[clin$OS_MONTHS > 0,]
path_filt <- path_df[clin$OS_MONTHS > 0,]
# create a survival object consisting of times & censoring
surv_filt <- Surv(time = clin_filt$OS_MONTHS,
```

### Build multi-omics feature matrix

```{r}
CNA_filt <- basal_CNA[clin$OS_MONTHS > 0, ]
CNA_filt[is.na(CNA_filt)] <- 0

#keep only common genes
common_filt <- intersect(colnames(RNA_filt), colnames(CNA_filt))

#add prefix to tell apart
RNA_for_model <- RNA_filt[ , common_filt]
CNA_for_model <- CNA_filt[ , common_filt]
colnames(CNA_for_model) <- paste0('CNA_', colnames(CNA_for_model))

#combine into 1 matrix
multi_omics_mat <- cbind(RNA_for_model, CNA_for_model)
cat('Multi-omics feature matrix:',
    nrow(multi_omics_mat), 'patients x',
    ncol(multi_omics_mat), 'features\n')

```

### Finding Optimal Alpha

```{r}
# finding optimal alpha
lena = 11
cvafit <- cva.glmnet(as.matrix(RNA_filt),surv_filt,alpha=seq(0, 1, len = lena),nfolds=10,family="cox",type.measure = "C")
```

```{r}
# plotting results of alpha scan
cvafit$cvms <- NULL
cvafit$cvss <- NULL
for (i in 1:lena) {
  cvafit$cvms <- c(cvafit$cvms, max(cvafit$modlist[[i]]$cvm))
  cvafit$cvss <- c(cvafit$cvss, max(cvafit$modlist[[i]]$cvs))
}
plot(seq(0, 1, len = lena),cvafit$cvms,type = 'b',xlab='alpha',ylab='C-index',ylim=c(0.4,0.8))
arrows(x0=seq(0, 1, len = lena), y0=cvafit$cvms-cvafit$cvss, x1=seq(0, 1, len = lena), y1=cvafit$cvms+cvafit$cvss, code=3, angle=90, length=0.1)
```

### Plotting Alpha C-index

```{r}
# chosing optimal alpha
opt_i <- which.max(cvafit$cvms)
opt_a <- cvafit$alpha[opt_i]
# we can select alpha manually instead
#opt_a <- 0.1
```

```{r}
# CV glmnet
cvfit <- cv.glmnet(as.matrix(RNA_filt),surv_filt,family="cox",type.measure = "C",alpha = opt_a)
plot(cvfit)
```

### Plotting Lambda C-index

```{r}
# selecting optimal lambda
opt_i <- which.max(cvfit$cvm)
opt_l <- cvfit$lambda[opt_i]
```

```{r}
# analysing results
cfs = coef(cvfit,s=opt_l)
meaning_coefs = rownames(cfs)[cfs[,1]!= 0]
meaning_vals = cfs[cfs[,1]!=0,]
write.csv(meaning_vals,file='survival_coeffs_cvglmnet_RNAseq.csv')
print(paste(meaning_coefs,collapse=" + "))
```

### Optimal MPAK threshold

```{r}
# plotting Kaplan-Mayer curves
pathway = 'MAPK'
pathway_data = path_filt$MAPK
# sort age 
uni_path = sort(unique(pathway_data))
# store results
results_path = matrix(1,length(uni_path))
# do a for loop for every unique value of age mat
for (i in 2:(length(uni_path)-1)){ # Starting from 2 because the first element would yield no elements higher than.
  path_i = 1*(pathway_data>uni_path[i])
  # survdiff is the function from the survival package 
  logrank = survdiff(surv_filt ~ path_i)
  # store in results_age
  results_path[i] = logrank$pvalue
}
# Plot unique elements of age against p-value
plot(uni_path, results_path, log = 'y')
```

```{r}
# Select minimum P-value
min_p_path = which.min(results_path)
# here are 2 good thresholds, -1 and 1
opt_thr = uni_path[min_p_path]
# I recalculated the P-value as a sanity check
pval = survdiff(surv_filt ~ pathway_data>opt_thr)$pvalue
nplus = sum(pathway_data>opt_thr)   # how many patients we have in high group
nminus = sum(pathway_data<opt_thr)   # how many patients we have in low group
```

### Fitting MAPK km groups

```{r}
# fit Kaplan Meier model
path_filt <- path_filt %>% mutate(MAPK_group = ifelse(MAPK >= 1, "high", ifelse(MAPK < 1.001*opt_thr,"low","intermediate")))
nhigh = sum(pathway_data>1)
ninter = sum((pathway_data<1) & (pathway_data > 1.001*opt_thr))
nlow = sum(pathway_data<1.001*opt_thr)
#KM = survfit(surv_filt ~ pathway_data>opt_thr,data = path_filt)
KM = survfit(surv_filt ~ MAPK_group,data = path_filt)
```

### Multi-omics elastic net cox regression

```{r}
#glmnet on matrix
cvfit_multi <- cv.glmnet(
  as.matrix(multi_omics_mat),
  surv_filt,
  family = 'cox',
  type.measure = 'C',
  alpha = opt_a,
  nfolds = 10
)
plot(cvfit_multi, main = 'Multi-omics Elastic Net (RNA + CNA)')

#extracting selected features 
opt_l_multi <- cvfit_multi$lambda[which.max(cvfit_multi$cvm)]
cfs_multi <- coef(cvfit_multi, s = opt_l_multi)
selected <- rownames(cfs_multi)[cfs_multi[, 1] != 0]
cat('Selected multi-omics features:\n')
print(selected)
write.csv(cfs_multi[cfs_multi[,1] != 0, ],
          file = 'survival_coefficients_multiomics.csv')
```

### Extracting top risk and protective genes

```{r}
coeff_df <- read.csv('survival_coefficients_multiomics.csv', row.names= 1)
colnames(coeff_df) <- 'coefficient'

#keep only rna genes 
coeff_rna <- coeff_df[!grepl('^CNA_', rownames(coeff_df)), , drop= FALSE]

#sorting by value of coeff
coeff_rna <- coeff_rna[order(coeff_rna$coefficient), , drop=FALSE]

#most positive coeffs = worse survival (top risk genes)
top_risk <- tail(rownames(coeff_rna), 20)

#most negative coeffs = better survival (top protective)
top_protective <- head(rownames(coeff_rna), 20)

cat('Top Risk Genes (pos coeffs):\n')
print(top_risk)

cat('Top Protective Genes (neg coeffs):\n')
print(top_protective)

write.csv(data.frame(gene = top_risk),
          file = 'genes_risk.csv', row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(data.frame(gene = top_protective),
          file = 'genes_protective.csv', row.names = FALSE)
```

### KEGG - Protective and RIsk

```{r}
#convert gene symbols to entrez ids for kegg
risk_entrez <- bitr(top_risk,
                    fromType = 'SYMBOL',
                    toType = 'ENTREZID',
                    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

protective_entrez <- bitr(top_protective,
                    fromType = 'SYMBOL',
                    toType = 'ENTREZID',
                    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

#KEGG - risk
kegg_risk <- enrichKEGG(gene = risk_entrez$ENTREZID,
                        organism = 'hsa',
                        pvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                        qvalueCutoff = 0.5,
                        use_internal_data = TRUE)

#KEGG - protective
kegg_protective <- enrichKEGG(gene = protective_entrez$ENTREZID,
                        organism = 'hsa',
                        pvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                        qvalueCutoff = 0.5,
                        use_internal_data = TRUE)

#plotting
dotplot(kegg_risk, title = 'KEGG Pathway Enrichment for #Risk Genes')
dotplot(kegg_protective, title = 'KEGG Pathway Enrichment for Protective Genes')
```

### STRINGdb (use string db website instead)

```{r}
#intialising string db
string_db <- STRINGdb$new(version = '11.5',
                          species = 9606,
                          score_threshold = 400,
                          network_type = 'full')

#mappingtop genes to string ids
top_genes_all <- data.frame(gene = c(top_risk, top_protective))
mapped <- string_db$map(top_genes_all, 'gene', removeUnmappedRows = TRUE)

#plotting the network
# - each node is a protein, each edge is a predicted or known interaction
string_db$plot_network(mapped$STRING_id)

#saving interactions 
interactions <- string_db$get_interactions(mapped$STRING_id)
write.csv(interactions, file = 'string_interactions.csv', row.names = FALSE)
cat('No. of protein Interactions found:', nrow(interactions), '\n')
```

### Building RF model

```{r}
# building RF model
B <- 1000
# Building a RSF
status_surv <- clin_filt$OS_STATUS=="1:DECEASED"
time_surv <- clin_filt$OS_MONTHS
dataSetRF <- cbind(time_surv,status_surv,RNA_filt)

names(dataSetRF)<-make.names(names(dataSetRF))

RF_obj <- rfsrc(Surv(time_surv,status_surv)~., dataSetRF,  ntree = B,  membership = TRUE, importance=TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Printing the RF object  
print(RF_obj)

pred.RF <- predict(object = RF_obj, newdata = dataSetRF) #, subset = test.index)
```

### Comaprison of Subtypes

```{r}
#unfiltered data for plot
clin_all <- clin_raw[str_sub(colnames(RNA_raw)[-(1:2)], end = -4), ]

#keep only pats with valid survival data
clin_all <- clin_all[clin_all$OS_MONTHS > 0 &
                       !is.na(clin_all$SUBTYPE) & 
                       clin_all$SUBTYPE != '', ]

surv_all <- Surv(time = clin_all$OS_MONTHS,
                 event = clin_all$OS_STATUS == '1:DECEASED')

km_subtype <- survfit(surv_all ~ SUBTYPE, data = clin_all)

ggsurvplot(km_subtype,
           data = clin_all,
           pval = TRUE,
           legend.title = 'Subtype',
           xlab = 'Overall Survival in Months',
           ylab = 'Survival Probability',
           title = 'Survival by BRCA Subtype (Full Cohort)',
           ggtheme = theme_minimal())

```
